children: New Delhi, Sept. 2 -- Coal India share price jumped more than 4% in early deals on the BSE on Wednesday, 2 September, defying weak market sentiment. The PSU stock opened at Rs.405.25 against its previous close of Rs.402.50 and jumped 4.2% to an intraday high of Rs.419.30. Around 9:25 AM, Coal India shares were nearly 4% up at Rs.418.30. Equity benchmark Sensex was 0.88% down at 76,267 at that time.(This is a developing story. Please check back for fresh updates.) Published by HT Digital Content Services with permission from MINT.
